# ob-19 — Obfuscator may read and write Parquet and .ball through an optional DataBall adapter

The core stays native-free and CSV-only. A separate optional package uses DataBall for Parquet / `.ball` input and output, so users who need more formats opt into DuckDB natives. Revisit after DataBall v1.4.0 (databall db-17).
